question: Can a fixed track-conditioned multichannel raw-response score be calibrated on held-out single-muon controls, including high-activity/overflow tails, and what scope limits prevent transfer?

sources.production: s0012-r0023; geometry/release compatibility not yet certified

selection: single fitted long track, pz50-2000GeV,>=7layers, chi2/ndof<10; control-only selection, original ν cuts unchanged
split: original entry modulo4:0/1 response fit,2 threshold calibration,3 heldout; no scan or threshold tuning
features: Only log(pz0/GeV),x/y atVetoStation1,px0/pz0,py0/pz0 as reconstructed point-state. Never p0,p1,pz1. No fitted track covariance branch is certified: explicitly partial point conditioning.
readouts: Signed raw charge of11 scintillator+4 Calo channels; signed rawcharge/rawpeak effective duration50Q/rawpeak (ns) as second fixed arm. No fitted charge/width or continuous timing.
typed: finite -999/-9999/-99999 sentinels->NaN; signed charge -1 retained; positive rawpeak/baselineRMS required for shape/presence; WAVE_INVALID8|128|256 invalid; overflow/raw kept; status never gives nonzero timing
method: Multivariate ordinary least squares conditional mean; residual covariance (0.9 empirical+0.1 diagonal), no grid. Mahalanobis score; split-conformal95th rank ceil(.95*(ncal+1)). Original fitminmax state support only, missing/unscored events retained in denominator.
outputs: Observed heldout alert count/N and Wilson95, all/overflow/high-activity(train sumQ99th)/pz50-100 groups, coverage/missing/rank/readbytes/CPU/RSS, puremu truth audit in MC. Data alert fraction is not FPR. No natural-nu scoring or energy fits.
limits: One data run and one nominal100GeV MC file, split within file, no independent source certificate. No process radiation tags or track covariance. Local point-condition/pulse calibration only; old-X functions are representation, rawpeak already examined in Stage80, no new sensory-information claim. Not deployable calibration on current d32nu, not actual-background or full response certification.
stop: One frozen two-source control. No proxy/network grid or broad production; failures/unsupported branches retained. Next depends on measured support/calibration and real matching/covariance inputs. Overall goal incomplete.
